verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted AI assistant platform, and gating who can drive it is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no messaging-channel inbound gating: no sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating. The listed Authentication and Access Control pages concern web-app login and permissions, which is an adjacent control. The '@' mention is only a way to select an agent in the chat input, not a gate on who can send messages.
